description: Muting the author of a pen-name post stores the real user id; the muted list returns their name, handle and id
evidence: evidence/audit-probe-output.json p1_* : muted list contains real displayName after muting 'Night Kite'
impact: Any member can unmask any pen-name author through the normal UI; breaks the headline privacy promise
likelihood: High (two clicks; feature is in the post menu)
remediation: Key pen-name mutes to an opaque pseudonym id; never return the underlying user id/name to the muter

description: Author commenting on own pen-name post is serialised under real identity
evidence: probe p2_*: comment author = real userId/displayName
impact: Unmasking through ordinary conversation; no UI warning
remediation: Serialise author comments on pseudonymous posts under the pen name, or warn and block

description: round.excludeId (author id) and players[].waitingOn sent to all players in Who Said It?, Hot Take Arena, Memory Lane
evidence: probe p3_*: excludeId === actual author for both games; author is only player with waitingOn=false
impact: Game outcome trivially known; Hot Take Arena 'anonymous verdicts' promise broken
remediation: Move exclusion into secret; expose only me.canAct; hide waitingOn for secret-exclusion rounds

description: Events attached to private circles/groups are listed to all members (title, description, location); outsiders can RSVP
evidence: probe p4_*: outsider sees 'Secret circle dinner' at '12 Private Lane'; RSVP 200
impact: Physical location disclosure; contradicts 'circles are invisible'
likelihood: Medium (requires a circle admin to create an event; UI path exists)
remediation: Filter by group visibility/membership on list, RSVP, attendees and search

description: Setup resets mfaEnabled=false without password and without notification
evidence: probe p5_*: mfaEnabled true -> false after setup call
impact: Stolen session can silently strip second factor
remediation: Reject setup while MFA enabled or require password; notify

affected_component: social.ts:297-304 (feed visibility), social.ts:45-61 (canViewPost), schema/auth.ts:74 (default private), account.ts:166-172 (search)
description: Pen-name posts inherit the real profile's visibility and follow graph; 'following' feed shows them; search shows posts that then 404
impact: Anonymity set shrinks to the author's followers; inconsistent reachability
remediation: Decouple pseudonymous posts from real profile visibility and follow graph; exclude from following mode

description: Reset and verification links stored in plaintext in email_outbox.text_body; never purged
impact: DB read access => account takeover within reset window
remediation: Purge/blank bodies after send; short retention

affected_component: src/server/db/seed.ts:44-53; services/settings.ts:25; only circles.ts/play.ts call requireFeature
description: Dating, matchmaking, weddings, experts enabled by default in production; flags not enforced server-side
impact: Unmoderated dating/marriage features exposed at launch; admin 'off' switch ineffective
remediation: Default off; enforce requireFeature in all handlers of those modules or remove modules

impact: Full account takeover if compose is used on a public host
remediation: Auth-gate dev mailbox; bind compose ports to localhost; document
